title: Intelligence should compound
thesis: Useful knowledge and proven capabilities should remain available to the people and ventures that create them, so later work can begin with more context and less reinvention.

evidence.label: Local memory implementation
evidence.claim: The reference build includes local memory code and tests. This establishes a technical primitive, not reliable recall across ventures.

evidence.label: Capability packaging implementation
evidence.claim: The foundry has passing local skill-package paths. OpenAI plugin projection fails preflight on audited main; no cross-venture outcome is established.

evidence.label: Local multi-project sync
evidence.claim: Registered local project paths can contribute trajectories to SIS memory. The code does not measure whether a reused capability improved a later venture outcome.

interpretation: These local primitives make a compounding system plausible. The product thesis remains unproven until a capability moves between independent ventures with permission, verification, a baseline, and an observed outcome.
aspiration: Build an exportable record of useful knowledge, principles, discoveries, questions, warnings, and hopes that can survive changes in tools and institutions. Generational durability is a long-horizon aim, not a present product guarantee.
